author: SickProdigy
description: Audience-first interactive help that preserves Red command visibility and permission checks.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server-level help presentation settings and Discord role IDs for optional presentation groups. It does not store member activity or message content.
install_msg: AdvancedHelp replaces bare [p]help while delegating direct command and cog help to Red. Only one custom help formatter can be loaded. Configure delivery with [p]advancedhelpset.
name: AdvancedHelp
short: Permission-aware interactive help organized by audience.
